remarks: Exceptional opportunity in Compo Beach/Hillspoint neighborhood. Center hall colonial with end of cul-de-sac privacy. Minutes to beach, train, Longshore, shops. Wood floors, 2 fireplaces, central air, multiple sliders for light filled rooms. "Mill Pond" seasonal view from living room, kitchen, & primary br. Unique versatility and 2 "flex" spaces for home office with separate entrance PLUS studio apartment/ in-law/au pair with separate entrance. Possible rental income options for studio apartment. Convenient city water/sewer, deck, fenced garden space, solar panels, storage basement. Eat in kit. with dining area surrounded by windows. "Flex" space open to kitchen can be family room or formal dining...according to your lifestyle. Great layout, "Ring" system, sauna room, attic storage, primary br with balcony and vaulted ceiling. Bosch dishwasher, Viking double wall oven, Viking gas stovetop. Create your new home here!
